name: Ecoajedrez-AR
status: Celebración mágica ligera añadida para jaque mate/derrota/tablas y modalidades bot/local/online, con texto en 3 idiomas, nuevas partidas y menú; conserva tableros 0.14.1. Pendiente prueba física móvil/AR.
onlinePvP: Casual PeerJS beta, six-character code and QR with camera scanner (native BarcodeDetector / lazy in-browser jsQR), validation restricts invite origin/path. Real two-device session requires device test; unranked and unaudited anti-cheat.
modelType: Six tiny, original, embedded-buffer glTF Staunton types (one per piece kind), with Royal arcane 3D embellishments and procedural fantasy and classic variants; third-party character/franchise GLBs not included
arImplementation: WebXR hit-test with touch/aim + recovery dialog after interrupted Android session; screen-drag feedback, NOT camera hand recognition or hand occlusion
validationBasis: El usuario confirmó AR y funcionamiento invitado de v0.5; el nuevo 0.6 necesita pruebas físicas, entre dos celulares y desbloqueo.
googleAuth: Server-only BFF code exists but no Cloudflare Functions secrets deployed; Google unavailable on GitHub Pages; guest fully usable
localPersistence: LocalStorage por UID o invitado, sin servicio externo
diagnostics: WebXR, WebGL2, Firebase SDK, PeerJS, modelos, conexión, micrófono
securityReview: No external domains, keys, paid services, new login, third-party fonts, pixels or tracking; no changes to server and gameplay
ui: 0.14.1: 13 playable textures, 7 independent vista illustrations, automatic per-texture frame alignment; no manual grid coverage slider.

media.notes: Muted intro auto-start per browser tab/session (after page ready, if reduced-motion/data-saver/browser restrictions permit); stop at 10s video playback or 20s network stall cap; keep post-intro static backdrop. Asset downloads continue asynchronously. No auth/API secrets exposed.

visualFidelity: Functional reinterpretation of user's approved fantasy look, not photo-identical; uses existing user-owned video and poster; no unlicensed materials

modelCache.licensing: Original procedurally created models; legacy fictional-character models not included

environments.assets: Owner-uploaded 05–08 WebP existing, no new downloads
environments.AR: decorations hidden; WebXR camera passthrough remains clean; extended AR immersion postponed

boardTextures.imageMapping: 13 calibrated per-image grid rectangles projected to exactly 8x8 world units; frame dimensions and offset match; 7x7 WebP reconstructed as 8x8
